question: What simplified observance is permitted when a person is unable to perform the full rites?
premises: A person may be unable to perform the full rites
The text addresses the lords of sages
inference: If unable, one should perform only the festival, O lords of sages.
uncertainties: The form munmunīśvarāḥ is unusual and may be a textual variant.
plain_english: If one is unable, O lords of sages, one should perform only the festival.
